answer_1.quote: GRACE records human and computer guess correctness on interruptible questions designed to challenge model calibration.
answer_1.outputs: generated answers to incremental questions with confidence scores

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the calibration error of six LLMs on GRACE using existing metrics (ECE and Brier scores; Appendix G) and CALSCORE ( § 4).

answer_4.quote: We collect human responses from live QA competitions we conduct.
answer_4.guideline: Players press a physical buzzer when confident in an answer, and the moderator verifies if the answer is correct. We log the timing of human teams' buzzes and answer correctness.
